claim: MentraOS adds version-verified Private Cloud bootstrap
summary: October 7 MentraOS commit publishes a stable Private Cloud installer channel and a bootstrap that verifies SHA-256, pins versioned packages, and avoids silently switching an existing deployment. The documented reference deployment uses Azure; private-cloud is not equivalent to offline/local execution. Treat this as a code-published capability, not a deployment tested by GlassesResearch.
